title: Unit 7: Viet Nam and International Organisations

lessons.title: Lesson 1: International Organisations Vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: International Organisations Vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Comparatives compare 2 entities (short adj + -er + than / more + long adj + than). Superlatives compare 1 against a whole group (the + short adj + -est / the most + long adj).
concepts.example: Viet Nam is becoming more active in peacekeeping missions. It is one of the most dynamic economies in Southeast Asia.
concepts.essence: Degrees of quality across relative benchmarks.

rules.meaning: good -> better -> the best; bad -> worse -> the worst; far -> farther/further -> the farthest/furthest.
rules.example: Cooperation leads to better economic growth than trade barriers.
rules.essence: Historical etymology preserves suppletive comparative forms.

workedExamples.prompt: Complete: 'Joining international trade organizations has made our economy much (competitive) than before.'
steps: Step 1: 'competitive' is a long adjective (4 syllables).
Step 2: 'than' signals comparative degree => use 'more competitive'.

commonMistakes.mistake: Double comparison: writing 'more better' or 'the most easiest'.
commonMistakes.why: Never use 'more' with -er adjectives, or 'most' with -est adjectives.
